methods.label: Check the perfect-square pattern
methods.explanation: \(x^2-4x+4=x^2-2\cdot x\cdot2+2^2=(x-2)^2\). In \(x^2+4x+16\), the middle term would need to be \(\pm8x\); the other polynomials also do not fit the form \(a^2\pm2ab+b^2\).
methods.levelReason: Checking the three terms against the perfect-square formula is a grade 8 procedure.
